note: Lessons -> rules loop. Each post-mortem proposes at most 3 rules for the next week; Andy accepts them. Cash tickets only; promo/bonus/free-bet tickets are exempt. Managed by reports/bets/season-recap/scripts/rules.py.

rules.text: Max 3-4 legs per cash ticket (6+ leg stacks are promo/bonus only)
rules.retired_why: Replaced by R9-1 (max 6) after Week 9: max 4 was not followed (11 of 21 cash tickets)

rules.text: One read on at most 2-3 cash tickets
rules.source: Week 8 post-mortem (Okonkwo receptions x5, Warren receiving x4)

rules.text: Prefer rushing-lane legs; receiving props at the lowest rung offered
rules.check_note: Proxy: flags a receiving leg on a cash ticket when the same player/market appears at a lower rung on another ticket that week.

rules.text: No totals or same-team prop stacks on a shaky-QB game until inactives are out
rules.source: Week 8 post-mortem (Lamar left BAL@BUF on the first series)

rules.text: Cash tickets max 6 legs; 7+ leg stacks are promo/bonus only
rules.why: Week 9: C1 (max 4) broken on 11 cash tickets; 7+ leg cash went 0/4 (-37.88) while 4-6 leg cash netted +297.43

rules.text: Cash tickets max 4 legs; 5-6 legs only on DraftKings Predictions; 7+ promo only. A round robin counts its combination size. Cash tickets and the Alejandro split are built from the core four (QB INT, passing TDs, receptions, tackles), 3-4 legs at +300 to +600; on 3-4 leg tickets take rushing-yard milestones one notch lower. Island cash only at +400 to +1500; Island Tiers 2-3 promo only.
rules.why: Midseason audit #1/#4/#9/#12 (Andy 11/17): 5+ leg cash 4 of 198; core four 60-65% legs; Island past +1500 0 of 71

rules.text: At most 2 tickets per slate on one player (any stat) or one game total.
rules.why: Midseason audit #5: W10 64% of legs shared, Henry on 5 tickets

rules.text: Expert sides/MLs/teasers, best bets, Action Network, Ross Tucker, VSiN context only; expert totals flag only; splits/public fade never a reason.
rules.why: Midseason audit #6/#13: expert spreads -48.5u (441); public side 46-44

rules.text: Spread PLAY needs a 2+ pt fair-line edge vs BKR (flat-stake straight bet); otherwise LEAN. Every game gets a side LEAN and a total LEAN every week; a LEAN is never a cash parlay leg.

No A/B/C tiers: PLAY/LEAN/PASS with edge + basis on every line; props PLAY at 4+ pts over no-vig; probabilities shrunk halfway to the market. Props Unders first: an Over needs a named volume reason (core-four Overs exempt).
rules.why: Midseason audit #3/#8: Brier 0.252 vs 0.250; rec Overs 41-64, Unders 29-16

rules.text: Model fair total is not a reason. Under PLAY needs wind 15+ km/h or a named QB downgrade; Over PLAY needs a named non-model reason; otherwise LEAN.
rules.why: Backtest: fair-total edge 2+ went 11-23; Unders in calm/indoor games 5-14
